description: Authoritative machine-readable security invariant matrix (SEC-001 to SEC-010)

invariants.title: Missing Tier 2 Isolation Boundary
invariants.rule: If Tier 2 is requested and Bubblewrap or eBPF LSM boundary is unavailable, execution must fail closed without fallback.

invariants.title: Missing Tier 3 Virtual Boundary
invariants.rule: If Tier 3 is requested and /dev/kvm is unavailable, execution must fail closed unless explicitly permitted by policy.

invariants.title: Malformed HDS Contract Specification
invariants.rule: Any HDS specification violating schema or security contracts must be rejected prior to execution.

invariants.title: Domain Proof Root Mismatch
invariants.rule: Any mismatch between claimed proof root and recomputed 6-part canonical digest triggers immediate proof rejection.

invariants.title: Missing Runtime Execution Receipt
invariants.rule: Proofs generated without authoritative runtime receipt must fail closed with verdict NO_RUNTIME_RECEIPT.

invariants.title: Receipt Replay and Nonce Omission
invariants.rule: Receipts with missing, empty, or duplicate nonces must be cryptographically rejected to prevent replay attacks.

invariants.title: StateRoot Leaf Tamper Sensitivity
invariants.rule: Any mutation in policy, substrate, posture, provenance, or evidence leaves must strictly alter the Merkle StateRoot.

invariants.title: Age-Bounded Evidence Staleness
invariants.rule: Attested evidence older than 7 days must transition trust freshness status to EXPIRED and overall trust to CONDITIONAL.

invariants.title: Missing Security Policy Handling
invariants.rule: If the eBPF LSM security policy file is missing or unreadable, StateEngine must degrade trust status to DEGRADED.

invariants.title: Zero Silent Downgrade Enforcement
invariants.rule: If execution executes on a weaker backend than declared in the HDS, proof verification must reject with ISOLATION_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH.
